_help: npm .npmrc registry tokens. Each host uses 'env' (the env var holding the registry auth token). Optional 'scope' binds an @scope to this registry (e.g. GitHub Packages); optional 'always_auth': true. This file stores ENV VAR NAMES, not secrets — safe to commit. Delete the hosts you don't use. Writes MERGE into an existing .npmrc, preserving your other settings.
